thesis: No Anthropic dollar is spent before it is metered, capped and measured, and no user data moves before the disclosure covering it is live. The ledger, the per-lane Riyadh-day spend breaker and the consent/device request context land dark first. The router sends only consent>=3 traffic to Anthropic. One held legal PR plus the first OTA open the window. The KB is seeded through the Batch API (50% off) from legal sources, so warm compares cost about $0.001 (inferred) and web_search stays a capped last resort. Deferred: share, app speed, auth throttles, reviews, wider Sonnet use.

milestones.exit_metric: B4 PR merged on green with the flag-OFF pins intact; the MEAS-ZERO JSON records daily compare volume, the repeat-pair share, Serper calls per compare and credits left, the Console tier and credit expiry, and the 012 pg_policies, each with source, window and n.

milestones.title: Money rails before the first Anthropic token

milestones.exit_metric: Units 03-06 are byte-identical with the flag OFF (verify_flag_byte_identity base->head->base). MEAS-CLAUDE-GATE records a measured $/compare per mix and a go/no-go per role, with total spend at or below its approved budget.

milestones.title: One post-approval legal window, per-device bounds, text flip
milestones.goal: Legal v3 and the first OTA ship together; quota, fragrance gate and Anthropic text roles flip in runbook order; OpenAI turned off.
milestones.exit_metric: Legal v3 live in EN and AR. At least 80% of metered compares carry consent>=3 and a device header before the quota/text flips. Zero pre-v3 requests reach Anthropic (router metric). The 200-compare canary gives a measured $/compare, and the ledger matches the Console within 10%.

milestones.title: Knowledge base ahead of the Serper cliff
milestones.goal: Legal KB schema, registry with persisted robots and DENY_HOSTS, a Batch seed, ingest and KB-first serve, so warm compares skip paid legs.
milestones.exit_metric: At least 500 seeded juices, each carrying per-field provenance. SQL finds 0 kb_* rows with DENY_HOSTS provenance. KB hit rate and Serper calls per 100 compares measured before and after the KB-first flip.

milestones.title: B2 on the new brain and capped web_search
milestones.goal: Abstain when the KB cannot support a winner; web_search as a capped, registry-allowlisted last resort.
milestones.exit_metric: Abstain rate measured and within the owner bound. At most 1 search per compare. Daily search spend at or below the search-lane cap for 7 days. Every abstain is refunded.

milestones.title: Learning loop on a capped budget
milestones.goal: compare_runs ledger plus a nightly Haiku Batch judge inside the offclock cap.
milestones.exit_metric: compare_runs written for 100% of delivered compares. Nightly judge spend at or below the offclock cap for 7 nights. Sonnet escalations at or below 10% of judged runs.

units.title: SPEND-BREAKER per-lane daily USD caps
units.scope: Module llm_spend_breaker: Asia/Riyadh-day USD caps in four lanes (live, escalation for Sonnet, search, offclock). admit(lane, an upper bound computed from max_tokens) runs before dispatch; record(actual cost from llm_pricing) runs after. One Upstash EVAL does a microdollar INCRBY plus EXPIREAT. Caps come from ANTHROPIC_DAILY_USD_CAP_{LIVE,ESCALATION,SEARCH,OFFCLOCK}; when unset, the proposed defaults are $3/$1/$0.50/$2. Over cap: live returns a coded LLM_UNAVAILABLE plus refund; escalation and search are skipped and the Haiku result is kept; offclock is deferred. On a Redis error, live falls back to an in-process counter and offclock fails closed.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: zero Redis calls and no behaviour change
Per-lane trip semantics; a live trip refunds the credit and keeps the coded body
Key rollover at 20:59 vs 21:00 UTC (Riyadh midnight)
Two concurrent admits on the last cent never both pass (atomic Lua)
Redis outage: live uses the in-process counter, offclock refuses
preconditions: Owner confirms or sets the four cap names
units.risk: A cap set too tight turns peak traffic into LLM_UNAVAILABLE refusals, so the canary reads trip counts before any cap is lowered.

units.title: REQUEST-CONTEXT consent, device and compare-id headers
units.scope: A pure ASGI middleware reads three headers into ContextVars: X-AI-Consent-Version (int, else None), X-Device-Fingerprint (64 hex, else None) and X-Compare-Request-Id (uuid4, else None). A malformed value becomes None, never a 400. device_key() = HMAC-SHA256(DEVICE_KEY_PEPPER, fp), with a dual read of DEVICE_KEY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS for rotation. Raw values are never logged, never set as Sentry tags and never stored. Flag OFF: pass-through and every context stays None. Consumers: the router consent gate, device quota, refusal budget and compare_runs.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: response bytes and headers are identical and every ContextVar is None
Malformed values yield None and a 200
Pepper unset: device_key returns None and one metric fires
Header values are absent from caplog and from Sentry event payloads
Context stays isolated across concurrent requests and survives streaming responses
preconditions: Owner sets DEVICE_KEY_PEPPER on web (name only) before S81-09 flips
units.risk: Wrong middleware order relative to request_id/security could drop the context on the stream route.

units.title: ANTHROPIC-ROUTER per-role, consent-gated adapter
units.scope: llm_router sits above guarded_llm_create; with every flag OFF it is an exact pass-through. A role goes to Anthropic only when the request's consent version is 3 or higher; otherwise it goes to OpenAI while ENABLE_OPENAI_PRE_V3 is ON, else returns a coded CONSENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED plus refund. guarded_anthropic_create has its own breaker, typed errors (including 529), max_retries 1, and records breaker admission and ledger usage BEFORE raising on refusal or max_tokens. Calls send no temperature or prefill, run with thinking off at effort low, use output_config.format and re-sized caps. Sonnet runs only as a capped escalation. The Claude reviews prompt never asks for an estimated rating or total. SR8 pin, env-safety entry and a gated processors row ship in the same PR.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: kwargs reaching guarded_llm_create are byte-identical at all 16 sites, and metadata.openai is unchanged

Pins redden by design and are rewritten in the PR: test_u3c_store_false_pin 01/01b/01c/02, test_model_config_enforced >=15, test_model_config.py:135 claude regex, T7b test_legal_docs_u8.py:763, test_sentry_channels_u8d BASE_INTEGRATIONS
Netguard: consent 2 or None never reaches api.anthropic.com
Refusal and max_tokens: the ledger row and breaker record exist before LLMUnavailableError
529/overloaded maps to typed transient; extraction_service.py:2665-2678 never sees Anthropic text; at most 1 retry
Escalation fires only on the listed Haiku failures, at most once per compare, and is skipped when its lane is over cap

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in tests/_env_safety.CREDENTIALS_UNSET and the netguard

units.title: MEAS-CLAUDE-GATE spike, eval and parity
units.scope: Owner-run and owner-approved, at most $15 in the offclock lane. Inputs are L2-rebuilt or owner-written; no user query, id, cohort or profile goes to Anthropic before consent v3. Per role: count_tokens; a 20-call spike recording TTFT, end-to-end time and usage (Haiku with thinking off; Sonnet with between_tools); one web_search_20250305 turn alone and one combined with output_config.format; cache_read across format changes; an image block with the B3 schema; the Arabic verdict at its token cap. Eval: a 60-case fragrance gold set (gpt-4o vs Haiku vs Haiku->Sonnet), smoke20, WINNER_INDEX_MISMATCH, refusal rate and 100-case moderation parity.
tests: The script refuses any input carrying user_id, cohort, profile, email or device keys
It will not run without --budget-usd and stops at that budget through the offclock lane
Prod-HTTP runs are is_synthetic and quota-exempt
Output records n, window, model id and settings per row
Only token counts and labels are written; no prompt text and no API key value

units.title: CLIENT-FIRST-OTA headers and new device id
units.scope: In api.ts every metered request sends three headers: the axios interceptor, both attempts of the camera raw fetch, the SSE headers and /usage/status. X-AI-Consent-Version carries the stored record, else 0. X-Device-Fingerprint carries the device hash. X-Compare-Request-Id is a uuid v4 per compare, reused on /feedback and /events. The fingerprint becomes a Keychain UUID with an IDFV fallback and no osBuildId; the old hash rides alongside for one release so referral SAME_DEVICE and users.device_fingerprint_hash can migrate. The consent record is keyed to device and account. Merge now; ships in the first post-approval OTA.
tests: All four request paths carry the three headers (jest mocks of axios and fetch)
Source pin: osBuildId and osInternalBuildId are never read
The consent header equals the stored record version, or 0 when there is none
compare_request_id is identical on the compare and its /feedback call
The old hash is still sent in the referral body; behaviour is unchanged when the server ignores the headers
preconditions: Owner updates the App Privacy label before the OTA
units.risk: If a metered path is missed (camera raw fetch), the costliest request stays account-only and consent-unknown, so it falls to non-delivery once OpenAI is off.

The device INCR runs before the lifetime-free branch. consume_comparison_credit gains a device_fp kwarg that defaults to the request context, and the device key joins consumed_keys. _refund_credit_sync and _previous_daily_key learn the device key. One Riyadh date-key helper serves consume, refund and status. retry_after plus an allow-listed resets_at/scope reach the wire via http_exception_handler. The review demo account and device are exempt. No header = account-only plus a metric. Adds the refusal-budget key.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: keys, TTLs and the 429 body are byte-identical
Pins redden by design and move with S81-12: the TIER_LIMITS-vs-ToS parity pins in test_legal_disclosure_s77 and test_register_benefits_parity_s69
Two accounts on one device share 3/day; a refund restores both keys
Rollover at 21:00 UTC; status and consume agree on the key
Redis outage: the stated fail-open plus a metric; demo allowlist exempt

units.title: FRAGRANCE-ONLY-GATE zero-cost refusal
units.scope: category_gate runs before the credit consume and the preferences read. (1) A positive non-fragrance category word refuses at $0. (2) A KB or lexicon positive proceeds. (3) Otherwise consume, parse, then refuse right after _resolve_pair_category and before _fetch_product_data, refund, and count the refusal on the S81-09 budget (10/day/device); past that budget it returns 429 with retry_after and never spends a credit. The Haiku residue classifier runs only at consent>=3. Refusals return COMING_SOON for skincare and makeup and hidden for the rest. version_routes adds categories_live; coming_soon_tap is allowed; trending, smart pick and history are filtered.

A brand-only fragrance pair is not refused (the 'other' trap)
A non-fragrance pair is refused with zero LLM and zero Serper calls (netguard + call count)

Consent below 3 never calls the residue classifier

units.title: LEGAL-V3 one-window legal unit
units.scope: One held PR, merged first in the window. It replaces every OpenAI mention in the privacy policy and Terms (EN and AR, landing terms included) and the consent copy. It covers Anthropic as processor (30 days API, 29 Batch, 2 years flagged), its search subprocessor, the OpenAI transition and the end of data sharing, the Bahrain PDPL art. 12-13 transfer basis, the minors statement and AI disclosure for 13+, deletion vs processor copies, TTLs (device counters about 25 h, auth 6 h, compare_runs), 3/day/device with the Riyadh reset, referral text, Sponsored/CTA independence and citations. units.title: FLIP-WINDOW and COST-CANARY runbook
units.scope: After approval, in order, with one canary per step: (1) merge LEGAL-V3 and deploy backend and landing; (2) OTA S81-08, S81-11 and the v3 copy; (3) ledger, breaker and request context ON; (4) quota, Riyadh reset and the fragrance gate once at least 80% of metered compares carry a device header; (5) TEXT, then VERDICT and CRITIC for consent>=3; (6) MODERATION after parity; (7) VISION on the owner's yes; (8) close the pre-v3 window and turn OpenAI off. Each canary: 200 compares giving $/compare, latency, refusals, trips and runway.
tests: Before each flip: the previous state is byte-identical on a smoke pair
After 24 h the ledger matches the Console within 10%
Every breaker trip is logged with its lane and explained
The consent>=3 share is read from the request-context metric before steps 4-5
smoke20 green after each step; rollback = flag off, rehearsed once
units.risk: Flipping before most clients send consent>=3 sends the rest to non-delivery once OpenAI is off; the 80% gate and the pre-v3 window absorb that.

units.title: KB-SCHEMA migrations 046-047 and kb_service
units.scope: Migration 046 creates: kb_products (id = spine brand axis + identity tokens, no ml); kb_variants (concentration + ml); kb_offers (amount, observed_currency, evidence rung, captured_at, a latest view and a prune function); kb_images (URL + provenance only); kb_specs (value, source_url, host); kb_reviews (a source enum rejecting DENY_HOSTS; aggregate, count, URL); kb_gaps; kb_merchants (robots_state, status, blocked_reason, tos, deny, partner fields). Service-role RLS, plus the kb_product_card and kb_upsert_compare RPCs. Migration 047 REVOKEs the 012 policies and runs a postcheck. kb_service calls go through run_db.

kb_product_card returns one row per product in one call
The 047 postcheck fails if any 012 USING(true) policy remains

units.title: REGISTRY-ROBOTS-DENY persisted registry
units.scope: kb_merchants is seeded from data/bh_gcc_sources.json plus the 44 literals (country and genuine_method kept; fragrantica and parfumo excluded) and read per call through a 5-15 min per-process memo. Flag OFF: SOURCE_REGISTRY byte-identical. One DENY_HOSTS module serves source_router (the :347 literal goes), rating_service (:37, :46), the descriptor, ingest and search. Live robots is a lookup of the persisted QarenBot verdict; missing or expired = skip + queue. Candidate -> live needs robots, a platform probe, one PDP and a ToS ok. Challenge or unreadable = blocked + reason.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: SOURCE_REGISTRY and the router output are byte-identical
test_rating_tiers reddens by design (fragrantica leaves RATING_TIER_2)
Netguard: no robots.txt fetch on the live path
A missing or expired verdict skips the host and enqueues a re-read
AST pin: DENY_HOSTS is the only deny literal list; a challenge marks the host blocked with a reason
preconditions: Owner publishes the QarenBot contact page
Robots precomputed for every live host before the flip

units.title: KB-SEED-BATCH held corpora and feed walk
units.scope: Haiku 5.5 Message Batches (thinking disabled, output_config JSON, 50% rate) run over the held corpora (92 Gulf PDPs, 414 global pages), then a QarenBot feed walk of the 24 bulk-feed hosts (Bahrain first, ranked by merchant count). Only robots-allow, blocked=false, ToS-ok rows are used; pages with notes beside a Fragrantica/Parfumo/Basenotes link are skipped; each field records its provenance host; keys are per juice. Usage is logged for the first 20 rows and the run aborts above 2x the R15 per-row estimate. Spend goes through the offclock lane and the spend ledger. Public content only; batches are deleted after retrieval.
tests: A row lacking a robots allow or a ToS verdict is refused
A page with notes beside a deny-host link is skipped
The run aborts on a per-row cost overrun and writes a ledger row per batch
Request-body pin: thinking disabled, no temperature, no user-derived field
Batches are deleted after the results are stored
preconditions: Owner approves the seed budget (at most $10) and creates the Railway cron service
units.risk: Feed walks at concurrency 1 with delays of at least 2 s are slow, so coverage is measured per run, never promised.

units.title: KB-INGEST write-back on every compare
units.scope: One RPC upsert per compare via to_thread at the success return after moderation (REST about :4706; stream before the complete yield, about :5564), never after build_comparison_response. Writes only: canonical URLs on registry hosts with readable-allow robots, identity confidence high, no placeholder identity, no Tier-3 or uncited Tier-2 value, no DENY_HOSTS row. Keeps the JSON-LD cand['image'] and price candidates with observed_currency. Misses feed kb_gaps with per-field completeness. The counterfeit filter is fixed for 'Replica', 'infused' and lv.
tests: Flag-OFF identity: zero added Supabase calls and byte-identical bodies
CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE and timeout partials never ingest
A link-mode non-registry URL is never stored; query and fragment are stripped
Exactly one RPC per compare (call count)
'Maison Margiela Replica' and 'infused' titles survive; 'silver' and 'velvet' are not luxury tokens
units.risk: Ingest is the brain's poisoning surface: a loose identity rule writes wrong cards that the KB-first serve then repeats for free.

units.title: KB-FIRST-SERVE and verdict cache
units.scope: Before _fetch_product_data, one gathered kb_product_card read for both products REPLACES the L2 read; a full hit skips Serper, scrapers and the extract LLMs. KB price is served with its age: build 3 keeps 24 h converted / 7 d genuine, and older prices go only to clients sending the as-of header. Image = KB, JSON-LD or placeholder. Refresh is queued, never inline. Verdict cache key = ordered pair + card versions + scores hash + winner index + lang + model + prompt digest. It serves no-preference users only, returns deep copies, and is never seeded from a non-supported row.
tests: Flag-OFF identity
A full KB hit makes zero Serper and zero extract-LLM calls, and at most 1 Supabase round trip per product
A swapped pair order never reuses the other orientation
A user with preferences, cohort or profile never receives a cached verdict
Build 3 never sees a price past its TTL; mutating a cached verdict does not leak across requests
preconditions: S81-17 merged with ingest canaried for at least 7 days
KB read p50 measured in the canary
units.risk: A wrong card now serves at zero cost to every later user; the card version in the key and S81-20 bound the blast radius.

units.title: GAP-QUEUE operator path and enrich worker
units.scope: Admin-key operator path for blocked hosts (decision 11): a bookmarklet posts the JSON-LD, og:image and price of the page the operator's own browser rendered; plus manual entry and partner/licensed rows. Each needs the host's tos_reviewed_at and stamps provenance. Admin views: the blocked list, the gap queue by field and per-field completeness. An enrich worker (its own Railway service) drains kb_gaps on robots-allow hosts with the QarenBot fetcher (4 s, no fallback adapter, no impersonation), Redis single-flight, offclock lane.
tests: Flag OFF: routes return 404 and the worker exits at start
Requests without the admin key get 401; a host without tos_reviewed_at is refused
Netguard: the worker never fetches a blocked host
Operator rows carry provenance and never overwrite cited merchant rows
The worker stops at the offclock cap
preconditions: Owner creates the worker service and records ToS reviews for blocked hosts
units.risk: The bookmarklet must not become an evasion tool, so it captures one page per action from a normal browser session and is admin-key only.

units.title: B2-RESULT-GATE-V2 abstain on the new brain
units.scope: Re-spec from B2_UNIT_SPEC, BL1/BL2, Q1-Q7 and Q-R1..R7 on the new brain: abstain when the KB cards plus identity resolution cannot support a winner (placeholder, same identity, category conflict, no cited evidence). Exits per R-A3: INSUFFICIENT_DATA with a reason, refund with consumed_keys including the device key, no lifetime bump, no history row, no KB ingest, no verdict-cache seed, no Sonnet escalation. The camera refuses before the vision->compare spend. The flip is sized by the B1 abstain rate.
tests: Flag-OFF identity (B1 metadata unchanged)
Every abstain refunds both the account and device keys
Abstained rows never reach kb_upsert_compare or the verdict cache
A camera abstain happens before any Serper call
An abstain never triggers Sonnet escalation; B1 telemetry matches the gate decision
preconditions: ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA ON with the abstain rate measured
units.risk: Abstaining too often reads as a broken app at review, so the flip waits for the measured rate.

units.title: WEB-SEARCH-CAPPED live miss and nightly discovery
units.scope: web_search_service has its own result type (citations, HTTP-200 tool errors, pause_turn). Live: only on a KB miss, at most ONE search per compare, and only if the residual budget exceeds the measured search p95 and the search lane admits. web_search_20250305 is pinned (no code execution), max_uses 1, allowed_domains = robots-allow registry hosts. A prose call is followed by a separate structured extract. Stores URL + title, never cited_text. Nightly discovery: blocked_domains = DENY_HOSTS, capped, output = kb_merchants candidates.
tests: Flag-OFF identity
